articles.summary: Loan Origination Volume of $33.4 Billion. Net Income of $212.6 million. UWM Holdings Corporation (NYSE: UWMC) (“UWMC” or the “Company”), the publicly traded indirect parent of United Wholesale Mortgage (“UWM”), today announced its results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Total loan origination volume was $33.4 billion for the third quarter 2026. The Company reported 3Q26 total revenue of $811.1 million, net income of $212.6 million and adjusted EBITDA of $178.3 million. Mat Ishbia, Chairman, Chief Executive Officer and President of UWMC, said, “Our third quarter results show the strength of UWM and our ability to perform in any market. Even with rates staying higher, our origination engine, operational execution and service levels continue to set us apart. At the same time, the investments we’re making in artificial intelligence and technology are driving greater efficiencies across the business and helping lower expenses.
